t: Look up and around: this is The Horses of Helios, a bronze sculpture of four horses by the English artist Rudy Weller, born in 1956. It's one half of a commission installed in 1992, when the adjacent Criterion Theatre was refurbished. The other half is the Daughters of Helios, also called the Three Graces, a sculpture of three women leaping off the building six stories above you. Weller made both. Together they bring a bit of mythic drama to the front of the theatre.
